equity.level_reason: Age defines the population and sex is a stratifier; sex differences are described (females above baseline) without social-position framing, so the age-or-sex-only rule gives level 0.

level_alternative.reason: Sex-specific results are reported and emphasized ('particularly among adolescent females'), which a reader could treat as group-specific results by an SPD.
